verdict.rationale: Jules' usage-limits docs list a 'Power users & agent-heavy workflows' tier with numeric limits (300 and 60). A community user says it 'handles large quantities of tasks very well', and VM-per-task execution plus async notifications suggest parallel dispatch. The evidence never explicitly says these numbers are concurrent-task limits, and free-tier limits reportedly dropped to 15 daily tasks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the concurrent-task count and how parallel sessions run, orchestration/management of many simultaneous tasks, independent hands-on corroboration of concurrency at scale.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run many agent tasks concurrently to scale delivery throughput
